method: Single pass of the final source, including the commented token expansions. Checked credential signatures and URI/assignment patterns, encoded file headers, data URIs, long encoded literals, escaped-byte runs and long numeric initializers. Source locations are recorded without literal values. The separately verified PE FieldRVA table supplies an independent check for static byte storage.
scope_review: Reviewed grid forms, dialogs, view models, converters, serialization and compiler-generated members. Numerical operations in the UI include bound-value comparisons, WPF numeric scaling and generated hash arithmetic. No thermodynamic model calculations, database content, image payloads, embedded original PE or credential literals were identified.
